title: Fix swapped Alt and Super keys on Bluetooth keyboard
summary: Some keyboards activate Apple mode which swaps Alt and Super keys. Removing the hid_apple kernel module and reconnecting the keyboard fixes this.

steps.explain: Remove the hid_apple kernel module which causes the key swap.
Disconnect and reconnect your Bluetooth keyboard.

rollback.explain: Reboot the system to reload the hid_apple module and restore original behavior.

warnings: This change is temporary and will revert on reboot. To make it permanent, blacklist the hid_apple module.
